raw_segments.text: Macbeth, stay, you imperfect speakers, tell me more.
By Sinal's death I know I am Thane of Glamis, but how of Kador?
The Thane of Kador lives, a prosperous gentleman, and to be king stands not within the prospect
of belief, no more than to be Kador.
